en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes 1.67 percent higher at 23,919.50
en.dek: The benchmark recovered from an early drop to finish 393.53 points up on Wednesday, with the day’s high matching the close.
body: The Hang Seng Index closed 393.53 points, or 1.67 percent, higher at 23,919.50 on Wednesday.

According to Hang Seng Indexes Company data updated at 16:08 HKT, the index had opened lower before recovering through the session. The day’s high was 23,919.50 and the low was 23,385.29. The previous close stood at 23,525.97.
The rebound followed an early decline that had been led by technology and consumer shares. By the close the market had reversed those losses.

zh.headline: 恒生指數收升1.67% 報23919.50點
zh.dek: 周三恒指由早段低開回升，全日升393.53點，高位與收市水平相同。
body: 根據恒生指數公司於下午四時零八分更新的數據，指數早段低開後逐步回升。全日最高位為23919.50點，最低位為23385.29點。上日收市報23525.97點。
早段科技及消費股曾拖累大市，其後買盤回籠，尾市收復失地。
